positive_findings: Every velocity-sign and angular-bin contribution summed back to the exact Stage-72 x-direction map within the frozen closure guard.
The positive-vx and negative-vx absolute contributions were exactly balanced at 50 percent each.
The four fixed vertical-oblique sectors carried 74.56486709250579 percent of the fine-grid angular magnitude.
negative_findings: The grouped x-direction map remained strongly signed-cancellation dominated; its signed sum was only -2.9327325785204748e-05 of its absolute sum.
Velocity-group residual magnitude is not an adjoint sensitivity and does not predict a converged q_av response.
The failed Stage-28 MUSCL endpoint remains unrecovered and was not extended across Knudsen number.
No physical, collision, correction-floor, source-relaxation, transport, wall, normalization, or velocity-quadrature parameter was retuned.
